entries.title: Refine repository-aware project workspaces
entries.rationale: Accept the repository-aware project behavior, but do not take the 188-file upstream tree wholesale. Zion adaptation must preserve local-community relay targeting, signer and relay scope binding, path validation, sidecar restrictions, tenant isolation, retention migration safety, and Zion-visible branding. The change is too large for immediate single-pass inclusion and overlaps 119 current Zion paths.
security_reasons: workspace and relay scope transitions affect tenant isolation and signer binding
repository actions expand local filesystem and git mutation surfaces
best-effort retention migration requires failure and retry validation
project metadata enters agent context and must remain untrusted

tracking.implementation_plan: Implement incrementally: repository model/API compatibility; scoped workspace and relay safety; repository-aware UI; project persistence; rendered desktop E2E. Adapt all visible Buzz labels and examples to Zion while retaining required compatibility identifiers. Add race, cancellation, migration, path-validation, and relay-target tests before inclusion.

verification: Full-SHA provenance, 188 changed paths, upstream PR body, security-sensitive workspace/relay scope, retention transition, branding, and compatibility surfaces reviewed; no source implementation made.
